title: Monument C2: The portal tower, redrafted
request:
Redraft the tale for Monument C2 (The portal tower). Two earlier versions are source material: use any of their facts and jokes, copy neither whole.
- Prototype 7.13 (Farsight's voice; Farsight must not appear): The high road runs through this tower at the sixth floor. The tenants say the traffic is good company. Today your duty is on the road itself, at height. The view is not part of the job.
- Prototype 8.1 (Dummy Corporation): The raised road passes through the portal tower, above its tenants. Your write-off belongs on that road, at height; Certification does not include the view.
Choose the length the tile needs, 15 to 35 words in at most two sentences: short when one image carries it, longer when the place has a history worth telling. Name the place, keep the duty and any equipment the tile issues, and point the place at the training.
